summary: Veraxa Biotech AG filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, announcing the appointment of Christoph Erkel as Chief Scientific Officer, effective immediately. Erkel, previously Vice President of Research, succeeds Rick Austin after a transition period. No price, stake, premium, or advisor details were provided. The move is an internal succession, not a forced departure or special situation. This filing is a routine press release regarding a corporate leadership change. No regulatory clock or risk-arb angle applies.
